records.text: Candace Owens said an FBI plane landed in Salt Lake City on September 8, two days before Charlie Kirk arrived there, while explicitly noting that this did not mean Kash Patel was aboard.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I don't know, because journalism, but also because there was this FBI plane, definitively an FBI plane that landed into Salt Lake City, Utah on September 8th. So, you know, Charlie (Charlie Kirk), remember, he first went to Salt Lake City on the morning of the 10th, which I found to be very unusual that he would go there and do that weird restaurant interview, whatever it was, as his final interview. ... Doesn't mean Kash Patel was on the flight, but, you know, just doing a bit of journalism, ruling things out, asking questions.

verification.notes: The episode displays a claimed flight-tracking record and explicitly says it does not establish that Kash Patel was aboard. Live research found no authoritative government record or independently accessible historical flight record confirming the aircraft identity and September 8 Salt Lake City arrival.
